subject: ClearView: security questionnaire route and next steps
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Morris <evan.morris@clearviewmedical.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@clearviewmedical.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: ClearView: security questionnaire route and next steps

Hi Evan / Priya — great to meet you both on the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps on the security side so we keep momentum for the pilot: 

- SOC 2: You mentioned SOC 2 Type II is a requirement for production. We currently maintain SOC 2 Type II; I can share the latest report under an NDA.
- Data residency & HIPAA: we support US data residency and have HIPAA controls in our Private deployment (we provide BAA).
- Questionnaire: to move faster, would you prefer we: (A) prefill your SIG/CAIQ, (B) complete your custom security questionnaire, or (C) kick off with our standard prefill spreadsheet and attach SOC2 + evidence links? 

Attached: a short "ask" PDF that outlines what evidence we typically provide and a prefill template (xlsx).

My ask: please confirm preferred path (SIG, CAIQ, or custom) and a target date for kickoff. If SIG/CAIQ, let me know if you want the completed PDF or the Excel mapping first.

Thanks — I can follow up with a stub prefill by EOD tomorrow if you want us to start filling fields we can.

Best,
Karthik
Principal Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai

Attachments: ClearView_SIG_request.pdf (stub), redwood-prefill-template.xlsx (template)

From: Evan Morris <evan.morris@clearviewmedical.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-25T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ClearView: security questionnaire route and next steps

Thanks Karthik — useful recap. A couple of clarifying points from our security team before we choose the route: 

1) For SOC 2 — is the Type II report for the hosted Redwood service, or does it cover Private deployments as well? We run in a hybrid model and need coverage for both.
2) For HIPAA / BAA — can you confirm whether logs and audit trails are stored for at least 1 year and whether they can be exported on request?
3) On SIG vs CAIQ — we normally hand our vendor teams a SIG and prefer an Excel prefill to speed things up. If you can prefill, we may not need a full custom questionnaire.

If you can answer 1 & 2 and attach the prefill tomorrow that would be ideal. Also cc'ing Priya (security) who will review the prefill.

—Evan
VP Security & Compliance, ClearView Medical

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Morris <evan.morris@clearviewmedical.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@clearviewmedical.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-25T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ClearView: security questionnaire route and next steps

Hi Evan — answers inline: 

> 1) For SOC 2 — is the Type II report for the hosted Redwood service, or does it cover Private deployments as well?
We maintain a SOC 2 Type II report that covers our hosted Redwood service and the control plane. For Private deployments we offer a scoped control set and can provide the control mappings and evidence for components we ship; some customer-managed pieces (e.g., on-prem networking) are out of scope and we document the shared-responsibility boundaries. If helpful, Camila can attach our SOC2 summary mapping that shows which controls apply to Private/VPC deployments.

> 2) For HIPAA / BAA — can you confirm whether logs and audit trails are stored for at least 1 year and whether they can be exported on request?
Yes — audit logs and token-level traces are retained for 12 months by default in our Dedicated/Private plans; exports can be produced for compliance reviews. We can also extend retention with an add-on if you need longer retention.

> 3) On SIG vs CAIQ — we normally hand our vendor teams a SIG and prefer an Excel prefill to speed things up. If you can prefill, we may not need a full custom questionnaire.
Understood — we'll prefill the SIG Excel and return it with answers and evidence links.

Next actions I propose:
- We (Redwood) will start a partial prefill of your SIG using the attached template and include a SOC2 summary mapping.
- Camila will schedule a 30-min evidence walkthrough with Priya to go over any open items next Wednesday (11/3) at 10am PT — does that time work?
- If we hit any custom fields outside SIG, we'll flag them and capture them in a short open-items list for you.

I'll attach the prefill draft by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Karthik

---
On a related note: Camila — can you prepare the SOC2 mapping and evidence links (s3/drive pointers) and coordinate the walkthrough?

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>

Hi all — attaching our initial SIG prefill spreadsheet (redwood-prefill-template.xlsx) and a one-page SOC2 summary PDF. Highlights:
- SOC2 Type II: latest report period 2026-01-01 through 2026-06-30 (summary attached).
- Private/VPC: control mapping section shows which controls are covered by Redwood vs customer-managed components.
- Audit logs: 12-month retention by default; exportable in CSV on request.

Next steps: please review the prefill and mark any fields you want expanded; Grace will join the walkthrough on 2026-11-03 10:00 PT. Priya, if that time works I'll send a calendar invite and a short agenda.

Thanks — Camila
